title: Lab - Cluster upgrade process
description: Upgrade a kubeadm cluster one minor version.
scenario: Upgrade a kubeadm cluster one minor version. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Plan
tasks.instructions: What version is the cluster on, and what does kubeadm upgrade plan offer?
tasks.solution:
kubectl get nodes
kubeadm upgrade plan

tasks.title: Task 2 - Control plane
tasks.instructions: Drain the control plane, upgrade kubeadm, apply the upgrade, upgrade kubelet and kubectl, uncordon.
tasks.solution:
kubectl drain controlplane --ignore-daemonsets
apt-get install -y kubeadm=1.xx.y-*
kubeadm upgrade apply v1.xx.y
apt-get install -y kubelet=1.xx.y-* kubectl=1.xx.y-*
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart kubelet
kubectl uncordon controlplane
tasks.verification: kubectl get nodes  # new VERSION on controlplane

tasks.title: Task 3 - Worker
tasks.instructions: Repeat for node01 with kubeadm upgrade node.
tasks.solution:
kubectl drain node01 --ignore-daemonsets
# on node01: upgrade kubeadm, kubeadm upgrade node, upgrade kubelet, restart
kubectl uncordon node01
tasks.verification: kubectl get nodes  # both on the new version
